title: referenceOf
description: referenceOf: every kind, table, relation, stage and check, from the store's schema and check rows; buildReference keeps the answer while no data file or migration changes.

title: show
description: show: the record's row, parts, children and links, read from the store on each request.

title: runChecks
description: `runChecks` (each row's query on a few connections side by side, problems in run order, a failed query as one error, a product's check kept to its product's records) and `refusedWorkspace` (one `data-refused` error per refusal).

title: graphMap
description: graphMap, mapRootOf, kept per index and root

title: erdFor
description: erdFor, domainErd and aggregateErd: the boxes and lines, worked out from the space's index on each request.

title: recordHistory
description: recordHistory: the commits that changed the record's rows, read from git's log and diffs on each request (parseLog, changesInDiff).

title: spaceOf
description: spaceOf, iconField and colorField: each product as a space, in the products' ID order (useSpaceState).

title: readWorkspace
description: readWorkspace: opens the store afresh, gives each record its part rows (readRecords), fills the file facts, runs Lathe's checks then the product's on four connections and the coverage queries side by side; buildReference's kept answer. Its shape is Workspace in lathe/src/types.ts.

title: resolveCommands
description: resolveCommands, platformKeys and ariaKeyShortcuts: COMMANDS with the person's overrides, as the platform shows them.

title: themes
description: The built-in themes and the person's own (themes), with the one in use (active) and the color mode.

title: menuTemplate
description: menuTemplate's Open Recent items: each recent folder, latest first, shown with displayPath.

title: COVERAGE_VIEWS_SQL
description: COVERAGE_VIEWS_SQL: obligation_kind, coverage_owed, coverage_proof, coverage_item, coverage_count; pattern rules counted for proof alone

title: traceOf
description: traceOf, designersOf, buildersOf and notAutomatedTestsOf: what designs, builds and proves the record, by group, from the space's index; what proves it in a domain is the tests coverage counts as its proof there.
